info.name: supports a RESTful API for the Libpod library artifacts quadlets API

params.name: replace
params.description: Replace the installation files even if the files already exists

items.docs:
Install one or more files for a quadlet application. Each request should contain a single quadlet file
and optionally more files such as containerfile, kube yaml or configuration files. Supports both tar
archives and multipart form data uploads.

params.name: quadlets
params.description: Names of quadlets to remove (e.g., "myapp.container"). Required unless all=true

params.name: all
params.description: Remove all quadlets for the current user

params.name: force
params.description: Remove running quadlets by stopping them first

params.name: ignore
params.description: Do not error for quadlets that do not exist

items.docs:
Remove one or more quadlet files. Supports removing specific quadlets by name or all quadlets
for the current user. Can force removal of running quadlets and control systemd reload behavior.

params.name: name
params.description: the name of the quadlet with extension (e.g., "myapp.container")

params.name: force
params.description: Remove running quadlet by stopping it first

params.name: ignore
params.description: Do not error if the quadlet does not exist

params.name: reload-systemd
params.description: Reload systemd after removing the quadlet

items.docs: Remove a quadlet file by name. Can force removal of running quadlets and control systemd reload behavior.

params.name: filters
params.description:
JSON encoded value of the filters (a map[string][]string).
Supported filters:
  - name=<quadlet-name> Filter by quadlet name
  - pod=<pod-quadlet> Filter by Pod= value (container quadlets only)
